name: Dream! Fashion Star
source:
A modeling competition offers you a chance to fulfil your dream! Face new rivals and challenges as you climb your way into the high-fashion world. Dive into the glitz and glam of the fashion industry and make choices that will take you on a journey of a lifetime. Strike a pose and ask yourself, will the runway lead to love?

[From [url=https://memoriesinteractive.com/story/dream-fashion-star/]Memories Interactive[/url]]
